correctness.rationale: For n>=3 and 1<=k<=n-1, selected sets I,J and omitted X,Y, all vertices have k selected open neighbors iff |I|,|J|>=k+1. For nonfull sets, each outside vertex additionally requires k outside open neighbors: k<=|X|,|Y|<=n-k-1, with X∩Y=empty whenever one omitted size is k. Full S always feasible. Four binomial regimes give the displayed polynomial; gamma=2n for n<=2k and gamma=2k+2 otherwise. Independent literal adjacency/open-neighborhood and complement checking matched all criteria and coefficients for n=3..7, every k; in particular n=2k+1 boundary count checked. The argument is uniform and symbolic.
